thread:
priya: Brainstorm: instead of fixed pin windows, what if we offer pin credits? Customers buy X credits that buy them N days of pin time per model. That could simplify billing and allow fractional pins. Thoughts?
harold: Interesting. Ops worries: credits still map to reserved capacity. Need a clear conversion (credits -> reserved uplift + TTL). Also need to ensure we can schedule capacity ahead for large redemptions.
emma: From ML benches: we still need hard acceptance gates before any pin is allowed. Bench pass rules should be: embed P@10 >= 0.885 on seed set, generation factuality <= 2.5% on QA slice, and rerank MRR +5% over baseline. We should also record a "quality-cost tradeoff" delta between float16 and quant-int8.
jon: Pricing/product take: credit model can be 1 credit = 7 days of pin for one model at small reserved uplift. Larger bundles give discounts and enable 3rd-party migration support. It also lets customers reallocate credits across models.
priya: Ops-runbook idea: when a customer redeems credits, trigger a reservation window: reserve capacity for the redemption window + a 48h prewarm. If the customer cancels within 24h of redemption, auto-release but charge a 10% restock fee.
rachel: Legal/CS concern: customers want firm guarantees they won't be migrated during their paid window. Contract should say "no forced migration during active credit-backed pin window" and include a short SLA for performance.
harold: Can we synthesize a safe default: 1 credit = 7d pin, reserve uplift tiered: redeeming <=4 credits => +12% uplift, 5-12 credits => +25% uplift, >12 credits => +40% uplift. Engineers: can we model capacity for this?
emma: For gating: add an adversarial hallucination harness and require halluc_flag <= 2.0% on adv set. Also add a token-efficiency metric: tokens/sec delta <= 5% vs baseline. Bench command we'll use:

```
# pin_bench.sh
python bench.py --model beacon-v2 --seqs 64,256 --runs 600 \
  --suites seed,adv --metrics p95,p99,embed_p10,mrr,halluc_rate,tokens_sec
```

jon: Billing UX: show projected reserved uplift and estimated monthly COGS before checkout. Also provide a "credit lock preview" that shows which models would be affected by the redemption.
priya: Fallback policy for credit-backed pins: if a pinned model regresses >10% on p95 or halluc_rate increases >1% absolute for 3h, auto-fallback to last-stable and refund remaining full-day credits for the first 7d of the pin window. After 7d, refunds are prorated. Ops to confirm feasibility.
harold: Feasible but we need tracking: redemption_id, reserved_capacity_id, prewarm_start, and per-request tags (pin_redeemed, redemption_id). infra-bot: Added telemetry ticket INFRA-7882 for pin_redeem and retention policy.
emma: Also require we expose "credit_cohort" in Console so bench/telemetry can compare quality drift by credit usage.
jon: Marketing wants a simple starter pack: 4 credits = 28d across a single model or split. Recommend 2x markup pilot pricing and a flat per-credit add-on. Finance to model revenue scenarios.
rachel: I'll draft the contract language for the credit-backed pin, including cancellation, refund rules, and migration notice.
priya: Owners: harold -> capacity model + runbook, emma -> bench harness + adv set, jon -> pricing UX + bundles, rachel -> contract language. Decision needed by EOD Tue so we can pilot in next sprint.
infra-bot: Scheduled: bench-beacon-v2 -> queued. ETA 30m. CI gating required.
priya: Thanks all 680 I'll write a short spec doc and ping owners.
